slos.title: Resize FPS
slos.scenario: Synthetic 200-pane dirty-row loop with five-second gesture metadata; separate one-terminal 512-line resize correctness assertion
slos.measurement: Criterion sample of synthetic dirty-row enumeration cost; does not traverse TermWindow, mux/pane resize, full reflow, shaping, GPU, or display presentation

retained_evidence.reason: Remote RCH retained run passed on vmi1153651 with all 20 evidence rows within the 16.6ms p99 target and a retained maximum p99 of 106us. Code inspection on 2026-07-27 established that this validates the synthetic dirty-row loop only, not live 200-pane TermWindow/mux/reflow/GPU/present FPS.

slos.title: Input-to-photon latency (macOS)
slos.scenario: single keystroke on a CAMetalLayer-backed window with 80x24 pane
slos.measurement: End-to-end timing from known key event through deterministic headless frame flush; CAMetalDrawable lab capture remains a target-run refinement

retained_evidence.reason: A retained macOS target run now exists (2026-07-16, native Apple-Silicon Metal) but measured OVER the 16ms p95 target through the headless GPU-readback proxy on a loaded fleet host, so the bound is NOT validated. A quiet-host run (and ideally a CAMetalDrawable on-screen capture without readback sync) is still required before any validated claim.

target_run_attempt.reason: Native Apple-Silicon macOS run executed outside the Linux-only RCH fleet (frankenterm-gui is structurally un-offloadable: RCH-E307 x11-xcb; RCH_FORCE_LOCAL=1 per the documented gui-crate proof lane). Bench completed exit 0 with real Metal GPU. The result is a proxy with opposing confounders: the active fleet-controller load and forced GPU-to-CPU readback add work, while the substrate omits NSEvent delivery, mux/PTY transport, production-window invalidation, display scan-out, and photons. It is neither a pass nor a mathematical upper or lower bound for the 16ms claim.
target_run_attempt.command: RCH_FORCE_LOCAL=1 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ft-tf6g338-i2p-macos-target cargo bench -p frankenterm-gui --features headless-render --bench input_to_photon -- --sample-size 10

slos.title: Input-to-photon latency (Wayland)

retained_evidence.reason: The deterministic stage telemetry substrate is wired, but no retained Wayland target-run artifact proves the p95 bound.

target_run_attempt.reason: RCH admission refused on every attempt (no_admissible_workers: critical_pressure / active_project_exclusion / insufficient_slots); no admissible Wayland GPU lab host was reached. slos.title: Idle GPU usage
slos.target: 0% sustained when no semantic change for >500ms
slos.scenario: Idle pane with cursor disabled, no incoming PTY traffic for 30s
slos.measurement: Core scheduler/predicate paint-submission proxy from idle_gpu.rs; final retained lab proof should pair this with sampled GPU counters (Metal: GPUCommandBuffer.GPUEndTime; Vulkan: VK_EXT_calibrated_timestamps).

retained_evidence.reason: Source bench now exists and emits a scheduler/predicate proxy evidence row; retained RCH target-run artifact and platform GPU-counter proof remain pending.

target_run_attempt.reason: The RCH fleet is GPU-less / headless, so no Metal (GPUCommandBuffer.GPUEndTime) or Vulkan (VK_EXT_calibrated_timestamps) GPU-counter sampling is available for a retained idle-GPU target run; RCH admission additionally refused earlier sessions (no_admissible_workers: health_below_fallback / hard_preflight / active_project_exclusion). A `-p frankenterm-core --lib` run does not satisfy this bead, and the scheduler/predicate proxy bench MUST NOT upgrade the row to retained_run_validated without sampled GPU counters.

latest_fail_closed_probe.reason: Remote RCH admitted the fail-closed lib probe on vmi1264463 and compiled for 36m46s, then exited 130 via user-originated cancellation before the filtered lib test completed. This proves remote admission/Cargo reachability for the synced tree, but it is not a retained idle-GPU target run and includes no sampled GPU counters.

slos.title: Atlas rebuild count on pure resize
slos.target: 0 rebuilds during a resize sequence with no glyph additions
